mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mp_devops_alarm_statistics WHERE TO_DAYS( create_time ) = TO_DAYS(#{currentTime})

SELECT MAX( a.id ) as id, SUM( a.alarm_count ) as alarm_count, a.alarm_date FROM mp_devops_alarm_statistics a WHERE a.alarm_type IN ( 0, 1 ) AND TO_DAYS(#{currentTime}) - TO_DAYS( a.create_time ) < #{days} GROUP BY a.alarm_date ORDER BY a.alarm_date

SELECT MAX( a.id ) as id, SUM( a.alarm_count ) as alarm_count, a.alarm_date FROM mp_devops_alarm_statistics a WHERE a.alarm_type = 2 AND TO_DAYS(#{currentTime}) - TO_DAYS( a.create_time ) < #{days} GROUP BY a.alarm_date ORDER BY a.alarm_date
